extracted.stage: Children and finance proceedings with an upcoming hearing
extracted.summary: A solicitor asks whether a £2,000 loan for a single counsel's fee in a children and finance matter at the Family Court sitting at Cardiff, where around £249,000 of assets are in dispute, meets the minimum loan size.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry and for the clear summary of the position. So that we can consider it properly, we would be grateful for the date of the next hearing, confirmation of the nature and value of the assets in dispute and whether they are subject to any charges or other claims, and your client's details along with an outline of anticipated costs beyond this counsel's fee. Confirmation that you are instructed and will remain on the record would also be helpful. We will review the matter once that information is to hand and come back to you with any further questions.
